data.body:
RCA (Phase 1 complete) — flaky-test defect, NOT a product regression.

MECHANISM: test_reads_complete_promptly_while_write_lock_is_held uses ONE subprocess wall-clock bound (timeout=10) as the oracle for the product's <=2s reconverge-lock deadline (reads._RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT=2). But subprocess time = interpreter-startup + 'import rebar' + reconverge(<=2s) + read + JSON. The 2s deadline is a small fixed fraction; the dominant term (startup/import) is unbounded on a constrained runner. The single number conflates a fixed 2s guarantee with machine slack.

WHY THIN-HEADROOM (differs from sibling dire-negative-bunting): the genuine-stall signature here is only ~15s (revert the ledge to the sync._SYNC_LOCK_TIMEOUT=15 writer default), NOT 120s. So the sibling remedy (widen the single subprocess bound to 45s) is WRONG here: 45>15 would let a real 15s stall pass. A single wall-clock number cannot both tolerate CI startup slack AND stay under 15s.

PROOF (discriminating, runtime): in-process reads.ensure_fresh() under a held write lock returns in 2.09s at ledge=2 vs 15.09s at ledge=15 (overhead ~0.09s — a lock-timeout CEILING, not a workload, so machine-independent). An 8s ceiling sits cleanly between (fixed passes +6s, regression fails +7s). Full 4-surface subprocess test measured 8.92s total (~2.2s/call) locally at load 5-8; CI audit puppylike-emo-rasbora (815d-8f56) observed 9.43s — already within 0.6s of the 10s per-call ceiling. Reads ARE genuinely lock-free (the ledge works); the test catches ambient slowness, not a defect.

REMEDY (AC-aligned): SEPARATE the two concerns. (1) assert the <=2s product deadline IN-PROCESS via ensure_fresh timing (< 8s ceiling) — robust to startup slack, discriminates 2s vs 15s; (2) widen the per-surface subprocess bound to a generous LIVENESS bound (45s, far under the 120s hold) so CI slack across the loop never crosses it while a genuinely hung read still fails; (3) a guard test pins 2 < 8 < 15 and 45 < 120; (4) cumulative loop exposure is moot — deadline is a single in-process measurement and each subprocess has ~20x headroom.

DEFECT ORIGIN: introduced with the test in ecc5c8df623b 'Pin complete-or-loud reads for all sync surfaces' (rebar-ticket: fa6e-78c8-f806-4283). Fix site is the cause site; class=flaky, caused_by=fa6e-78c8-f806-4283.
